Oxum Island

By @sunr1se. Published 2026-10-17. Last updated 2026-10-30.

EVERYTHING FROM RUST IS HERE: gathering, crafting, workbenches, bases, tool cupboards, code locks, raids, upkeep, blueprints, scientists, airdrops, the heli and weekly wipes. And now we ship OUR OWN CUSTOM UPDATES on top: asteroids, the Depths, the Oxum-7 lab, survivor bot clans, the arena, Halloween and more, with something new almost every day. Hardcore Rust-style multiplayer survival on a cold northern island after the collapse. You wake with a rock and a torch. Nothing is given. YOUR FIRST MINUTES 1. Main menu: pick your language with the flags up top (RU / EN / UA), check the store, skins and settings, then press PLAY. 2. Server list: PLAY opens the server browser with live online counts. MAIN x1 (RECOMMENDED, normal mode), x5 (five times the resources), x1 000 000 (one hit fills your inventory) and ADMIN SANDBOX (everyone gets the admin panel on P: kits, fly, god mode). Each server keeps its own inventory, armor and base; coins, skins and settings are shared. 3. Prologue cutscene: a narrator over an old city at dusk. A countdown, a meteor tears out of the sky, a crowd runs at you down the avenue, the blast, darkness and ringing ears. You wake on your back on the island and get up. 4. Coming back later: no meteor. The island's last rusty bus drives across the map, pulls up next to where you left and opens its door. Logged out in the air? The driver fires two scrap rockets on the roof and flies the bus to you. 5. On the island: a FIRST STEPS list walks you through it: hit trees with your rock, craft a stone axe, drink at a lake, place a sleeping bag so you respawn there. Hints along the bottom: T chat, I inventory, M map, N menu, Z frees the mouse. G turns your flashlight on and off. GATHER AND CRAFT Wood, stone, metal ore, sulfur, hemp, berries, mushrooms, scrap. 3 workbench tiers, furnaces, recyclers, traders. A backpack slot that carries extra items. BUILD AND RAID Bases from twig to wood, stone and armored: foundations, walls, doorways, windows, stairs,
